title: Boilzone
description: Adds a new magma themed ocean biome.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dfec2c498a6fc1cf2e54c2cfdbfefae9cbb8d9d_0.webp)

Adds two new biomes: Boiling Reef and Drylands. Also adds new blocks, items and more.

**Boiling Reef**

The Boiling Reef is a new ocean biome usually generating in the center of deep lukewarm oceans or between deep lukewarm oceans and deep oceans. There are new vegetation in the Boiling Reef, for example: Magmashrooms. Boilfishes live in the Boiling Reef and if touched, they explode. They won't explode if you hurt them, but they will explode if you kill one. Boilfishes (item) can be used to make Poison Resistance potions. 

**Drylands**

The Drylands is a biome that generates the same way as mushroom fields (generating as islands), it has dead trees and bushes and is usually surrounded by a Boiling Reef.

**Uranium**

Uranium is a new ore found in the Boiling Reef, Ocean Dunes And Drylands. Uranium can be used to make some things, for example: Uranium Rods.

**Music** 

Music used:

- Voyage by Kaaosvos (plays in the Boiling Reef)
- Boildive by FrogDude5555 (plays in the Boiling Reef)
- Old Clockworks by FrogDude5555 (plays in the Drylands)
- Sphere by Creo (Music Disc, free to use if free, for example: a Geometry Dash level or a free video game)

**Secret Sands Update**

![Secret Sands Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a1282dd6f8639225bccda8402139d9e743b2cb5_0.webp)

**Ocean Dunes**

The Ocean Dunes is a new ocean biome that is a kinda like a underwater desert, with no fish.

**Ferrouranium**

Ferrouranium is a new metal alloy made from Uranium, Magmashrooms, Basalt and Iron Ingots. It can be used to upgrade Fishing Rods and Turtle Shells to Ferrouranium Fishing Rods and Turtle Shells.
